name: Chacha Chaudhary
summary: Pran's wise old man in a red turban, famous for a brain sharper than any computer. Created in 1971 for the Hindi magazine Lotpot and later a giant Diamond Comics hit.
origin: Cartoonist Pran created Chacha Chaudhary in 1971 for the children's magazine Lotpot. He drew on the strategist Chanakya and the wise elders found in every village, who solve problems with experience and humour. Chacha is an ordinary middle-class old man with no powers or gadgets, just a red turban, a wooden stick, a waistcoat and a very sharp mind. He lives with his wife Bini, his dog Rocket and Sabu, a giant from Jupiter who provides the muscle. Together they outwit corrupt officials, thieves, conmen and local thugs, who usually end up embarrassed.

storyline.title: Born in Lotpot
storyline.beat: Pran introduces the turbaned problem-solver in the Hindi magazine Lotpot.

storyline.title: Enter Sabu
storyline.beat: The giant Sabu from Jupiter visits Earth, tastes Chachi's parathas and halwa, and decides to stay as the family's strongman.

storyline.title: Raaka the unkillable
storyline.beat: Sabu's greatest enemy is Raaka, a giant made immortal by an Ayurvedic medicine. Sabu always wins but can only lock him away.

storyline.title: Live-action Chacha
storyline.beat: A live-action TV series casts Raghubir Yadav as Chacha Chaudhary.

storyline.title: Cartoon comeback
storyline.beat: Toonz Animation produces an animated Chacha Chaudhary TV series.

gossip.text: The comic has sold over ten million copies and appears in ten Indian languages.
According to the comics, a single meal for Sabu includes 202 chapatis and about 18 litres of lassi.
Whenever Sabu gets angry, a volcano erupts somewhere on Jupiter.
Chacha never locks his front door, yet nobody manages to rob his house.
Under the famous red turban, Chacha is completely bald.
Chacha Chaudhary is a superhero with powers.
gossip.truth: He has none. He wins with brains, a wooden stick and occasionally Sabu's muscles.

quiz.why: Sabu is a giant from Jupiter who chose to live with Chacha.

quiz.q: In which magazine did Chacha Chaudhary debut?
quiz.why: Pran created him for Lotpot in 1971.

quiz.q: What is special about Chacha's dog Rocket?
quiz.why: Rocket is billed as the only vegetarian dog in the world.

quiz.q: Why can nobody permanently defeat Raaka?
quiz.why: He drank from a bottle labelled Poison, but it held a sage's immortality potion.

quiz.q: How is Sabu's lassi served in the comics?
quiz.why: Sabu is served lassi in a big bucket or pot.

quiz.q: What does the word chacha mean in Hindi?

theme.tagline: One turban, one stick, zero villains left standing.

timeline.title: Born in Lotpot
timeline.note: Pran introduces the turbaned old man who outthinks every crook, in the Hindi kids' magazine Lotpot.

timeline.title: Raghubir Yadav plays Chacha
timeline.note: A live-action series on Sahara One casts Raghubir Yadav and runs for 415 episodes.

timeline.title: License India tie-up
timeline.note: Pran's Features teams up with License India to bring Chacha, Sabu and Pinki to the screen as animated characters.

timeline.title: Pran passes away
timeline.note: Creator Pran Kumar Sharma dies in August at 75, after more than four decades of Chacha strips.

timeline.title: Animated series
timeline.note: Toonz Animation's cartoon version premieres on Hungama TV and Disney Channel India.

timeline.title: Mascot for the Ganga
timeline.note: The Namami Gange clean-river mission picks Chacha Chaudhary as its mascot.

facts.text: A popular saying claims Chacha's brain works faster than a computer, which makes him a hero of intelligence in a world of strongmen.
The name is simple: chacha means uncle in Hindi, and Chaudhary is a title tied to landlords. Under his red turban, Chacha is also bald.
Chacha never locks his house when the family goes out, yet nobody has ever robbed it. In some stories Chachi locks it.
Chacha loves watermelon and cannot resist mangoes. An itch on his head or nose warns him that trouble is about to arrive.
Sabu, about 15 feet tall though stories vary, came from Jupiter and stayed on Earth after tasting Chachi's paratha and halwa. He has a twin brother named Dabu.
A single Sabu meal in the comics is said to include 202 chapatis, 14 kg of halwa, 22 kg of rice, 7 kg of vegetables, 10 kg of curry and 18 litres of lassi.
Dag Dag, Chacha's truck, is half machine and half human; it refuses to start for thieves who try to steal it, but when Chacha whistles it rushes over and crashes into whoever is bothering him.
Whenever Sabu gets angry, a volcano erupts on Jupiter, according to one comic panel.
Sabu's battle cry is Hu-Huba!, and he only sometimes shouts Jai Bajrang Bali. In some stories rubbing a lamp summons him, Aladdin style.
Rocket, Chacha's stray dog, is billed as the world's only vegetarian dog and drinks milk instead of eating meat.
After Chacha won a contest, he and Sabu made the immortal Raaka shave off his moustache as the price of losing.
Bini Chachi sometimes fights thieves with a rolling pin. One story reveals she was an actress whom Chacha once saved from goons who wanted her jewellery.
Chacha's twin brother Chhajju is less clever and causes chaos on visits. In one story aliens mistake him for Chacha and take him to Mars.

Raaka was a dacoit on the run who hid in a sage's house and drank from a bottle labelled Poison; the sage had written that word on his immortality potion so nobody would misuse it, which is why even Sabu cannot beat Raaka for good.

Raaka keeps escaping, so Chacha and Sabu keep sending him away: early stories dumped him in the deep ocean, at the North Pole or in space, and later ones used a whirlpool and a bottomless pit near a rocket launch site.
In the latest Raaka story, Chacha and Sabu turn him into a liquid, which the comic says is stored securely so that he cannot escape again.
The World Encyclopedia of Comics gave Chacha's creator Pran the title of the Walt Disney of India.

Chacha is the mascot of the Namami Gange clean-river mission, whose new comics, first in Hindi, English and Bengali, show him teaching kids to keep rivers clean; the Jal Shakti minister praised him as a cartoon whose brain works faster than a computer.
The giant earrings Sabu wears were a parting gift from his mother when he left Jupiter.
Pran's Wikipedia page says Chacha Chaudhary strips are held permanently at the International Museum of Cartoon Art in the United States.
Gobar Singh and Dhamaka Singh are the robbers Chacha mainly faces, and their schemes usually backfire; Dhamaka Singh's regular helpers are Paleeta and Ruldu.
Tingu Master is a tiny, loyal and unlucky man who is sometimes overlooked and accidentally thrown out with the garbage, yet he occasionally saves Chacha.
Chacha Chaudhary has sold over ten million copies and appears in ten Indian languages, including Hindi and English.

kidSummary: Chacha Chaudhary is a clever old man with a red turban and a wooden stick. He has no powers, only a brain people say is faster than a computer. When a trick needs muscle, his friend Sabu, a giant from Jupiter, lends a hand.

story.title: A sharp mind
story.text: Chacha Chaudhary lives with his wife Bini, his dog Rocket and his friend Sabu. He has no powers, only a very quick brain.

story.title: Trouble in town
story.text: Robbers and tricksters like Gobar Singh and Dhamaka Singh plan schemes, and Chacha sees through them by thinking carefully.

story.title: Sabu to the rescue
story.text: When muscle is needed, Sabu, a giant from Jupiter, steps in with his famous Hu-Huba cry and a huge appetite for halwa.

story.title: Raaka returns
story.text: Raaka, who cannot die, keeps escaping, so Chacha plans cunning ways to stop him from causing more trouble.
